comment: THE ICP GATE dataset (PRD section 5, P5: UK depth-first). facts/sector.js auditableCell() is the ONLY reader. A (sector, sub_sector, jurisdiction) triple is auditable ONLY when it matches a served:true cell here. No match means the engine refuses the audit with a stated reason; silence is free. sub_sectors '*' means every sub-sector of that parent, including unresolved (null). Sector keys must stay in sync with the canonical parent nodes in facts/vocabulary.js; sector.test.js asserts the sync when the vocabulary is present.
